item.title: Katie (Kaye) Hagen (nee Friesen)
item.description: Katie (Kaye) Hagen (nee Friesen) was born April 9, 1936 in Coaldale Alberta, to parents who emigrated from Ukraine. She was the second youngest of 7 siblings. When she was 14, her mother was diagnosed with kidney cancer, and Kaye missed much of her school year before her mother passed away. This inspired Kaye to pursue an education in nursing. Upon graduation from the Galt School of Nursing in Lethbridge in 1958, she moved to Hazelton BC, and began nursing at Wrinch Memorial Hospital.
